description: Read the delivery status of a message this account sent. Accepts the message id from `send_email` or the SMTP Message-ID. Returns `queued`, `sent` or `failed` — plus the relay's error string when the send failed. The vocabulary also contains `delivered`, `bounced`, `complained` and `delayed`, but the receive worker has no bounce ingestion and never writes them, so a bounce is not observable today.

id.description: The message id from `send_email`, or the SMTP Message-ID.

name: get_send_status
